limitations: Evidence class: numerical verification on ref-x86-64 (TRS2); the registered pairs N1 and C3 are regression fixtures with named independent checks (closed-form NET-02 tolerances, A29 closure, restart root, item-0 root), not empirical validation. aarch64 checks the R0 pins and replay in CI only.

Status tested, not reviewed: ADR 0072 is Accepted (2026-11-08, Frank); the review docs/reviews/RRC-review.md and its fix round WO-7 are recorded, but no reviewed status is claimed by the build lane. No local full gate was run; the merge condition is CI green on both architectures (CI run 42558001650 at 6b892b03).

L21 is narrowed, not lifted: edge 3's continuation exists under RRC-revision-v1 for a revision region whose nearest verified ancestor has the same declaration and differs only in registered operating values; everywhere else edge 3 is the sequential restart or unsupported. Neither continuation changes the active set.

L-COL-9 is narrowed only on the failing-first column case (G5, C3: a splitter edit inside a column region, control BOUND_BLOCKED); column end-parameter continuation is mechanism evidence only (F1, forced edge). A first solve, a structural edit and the default policy have none; a column with a pinned (non-two-phase) source signature has not been measured.

RRC-revision-v1 is not a superset of T06-revision-v2 (review M2): on every measured case where the continuation converged, the sequential restart converged as well, in fewer iterations; a continuation that stops part-way ends the step and the restart is not tried (one recovery per step), so it can fail where T06-revision-v2 converges; no registered case is rescued that T06-revision-v2 does not rescue.

Review notes left as notes, no action ordered (docs/RRC_HANDOFF.md): R5 ValueError on a corrupt bundle's rerun; the homotopy defect-guard omission; A3's dotted reason path freezes at release; G6 counters would differ by the spent amount where a refused opening spent property calls.
benchmarks/rrc/results-ref-x86-64.json (measured at 40fba287) lacks the harness's key g2f_opening_equals_source_over_free_columns (D-30); a future re-take adds it. Nothing registered moved.
